tasks.label: Create Hugo Post
tasks.command: $slug = $env:HUGO_POST_TITLE.ToLowerInvariant() -replace '[^a-z0-9]+', '-' -replace '(^-|-$)', ''; hugo new content posts/$slug.md; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $path = 'content/posts/' + $slug + '.md'; $quote = [char]34; $backslash = [char]92; $title = $env:HUGO_POST_TITLE.Replace([string]$backslash, [string]($backslash + $backslash)).Replace([string]$quote, [string]($backslash + $quote)); $emptyTitlePattern = '(?m)^title = ' + $quote + $quote + '\r?$'; $emptyAuthorsPattern = '(?m)^authors = \[\]\r?$'; $content = Get-Content $path -Raw; $content = $content -replace $emptyTitlePattern, ('title = ' + $quote + $title + $quote); $content = $content -replace $emptyAuthorsPattern, ('authors = [' + $quote + 'Daniel Monteiro' + $quote + ']'); Set-Content $path -Value $content -NoNewline -Encoding utf8
